description: Sustainable and Climate-Resilient Health Care Facilities Toolkit is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DHHS, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. The latest version of this information was renamed the Climate Resilience for Health Care (CR4HC). The Climate Resilience for Healthcare (CR4HC) toolkit is designed primarily for healthcare emergency preparedness professionals, as well as the multidisciplinary teams that participate in healthcare organizations’ emergency preparedness and resilience planning. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality. Assets: Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
